company.name: Amboras
company.team_size: 3 on Y Combinator profile; LinkedIn lists 2-10
company.funding: Pre-seed; backed by Y Combinator and other investors; amount undisclosed

evaluation.summary: Amboras is building an AI-native ecommerce platform that generates and operates storefronts, learns from first-party customer behavior, proposes and runs live experiments, and optimizes conversion, average order value, retention, and lifetime value. Its published AI Engineer role directly matches Paarth's production-agent, analytics, experimentation, backend-infrastructure, payments, observability, and system-ownership experience. The strongest application angle is reliable agent execution and evaluation tied to measurable commerce outcomes.
strengths: Directly relevant published AI Engineer opening rather than an inferred role
Production conversational AI experience serving 30000+ monthly paying users
Hands-on model evaluation, Langfuse tracing, feedback analysis, cost tracking, and large conversation datasets
Strong funnel, attribution, conversion, repeat-payment, and behavioral analytics experience
Distributed backend ownership across 11 microservices, queues, databases, CI/CD, logs, metrics, and traces
Payments and ledger experience maps to commerce infrastructure
React, Vite, Next.js, FastAPI, GCP, Docker, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and event-pipeline experience
Built and operated a customer-facing product and can reason about product outcomes rather than only model quality
Amboras is a very small YC team where broad ownership and founder outreach can materially affect access
gaps: No verified professional Go or Kafka production ownership; founding engineer experience suggests both may matter
No direct Shopify platform or ecommerce catalogue, fulfillment, tax, returns, or merchant-operations experience
No published evidence yet of building an autonomous agent that edits and deploys customer-facing storefront code
No relocation or US work-authorization path established
Frontend is not Paarth's first preference even though this role may require full-stack execution
unknowns: Whether the role accepts a remote start from India or internship-to-full-time arrangement
Whether Amboras can support eventual US work authorization
Compensation, equity, employment type, working hours, and relocation timeline
Exact production stack and required agent framework
Current paying merchants, revenue, retention, runway, and production traffic
Methodology, sample size, duration, and statistical significance behind the reported conversion-rate lift
Safety controls for agent-generated price, copy, offer, layout, and checkout changes
Experiment assignment, attribution, guardrail metrics, rollback strategy, and protection against short-term metric gaming
Whether the AI Engineer seat remains available after the careers page was last checked
evaluation.outreach_angle: Lead with the overlap between Times Astro and Amboras: production agents, customer-session analysis, conversion funnels, model evaluation, tracing, and business-outcome measurement. Add Renderperk as proof of end-to-end backend, payments, distributed infrastructure, and production ownership. Propose building the safety and evaluation layer for Amboras's autonomous storefront experimentation loop. Ask directly about an internship-to-full-time remote start from India and a later San Francisco path.
evaluation.proposed_artifact: Build a compact autonomous-commerce experiment simulator: ingest synthetic storefront sessions and funnel events; let an agent propose a copy, offer, or layout variant; require structured evidence and safety-policy checks; assign traffic deterministically; calculate CVR, AOV, retention proxies, confidence intervals, and guardrail metrics; record traces; and support automatic rollback. Include unsafe price changes, insufficient-sample conclusions, conflicting metrics, and prompt-injection attempts from catalogue content.

pipeline.next_action: Build or outline the autonomous-commerce experiment safety and evaluation artifact, apply for the published AI Engineer role, then send a personalized message to Amin Mokadem with Imad Mokadem as the second contact.
pipeline.notes: AI Engineer and Full-Stack Engineer are listed on Amboras's careers page. Public hiring language suggests a highly committed, likely San Francisco-centered environment; confirm current terms directly. Do not mark outreach or application as sent until Paarth explicitly confirms it.
